basis: The statement completely preserves the detailed statutory definition and requirements for an individualized education program under 20 U.S.C. 1414(d)(1)(A).
Preserves the exact statutory rule of construction in 20 U.S.C. 1414(d)(1)(A)(ii)(I) without omitting governing conditions.
Preserves the complete text and meaning of the rule of construction in 20 U.S.C. 1414(d)(1)(A)(ii)(II).
Accurately reproduces all statutory components and qualifications of the individualized education program team defined in 20 U.S.C. 1414(d)(1)(B).
Preserves the statutory excusal rule of clause (i), though independent application depends on the writing requirement imposed by clause (iii).
Preserves all governing conditions of clause (ii), though full standalone implementation is governed by the written consent requirement under clause (iii).
Preserves the requirement from 20 U.S.C. 1414(d)(1)(C)(iii) while clearly resolving internal cross-references to clauses (i) and (ii).
Preserves all stated conditions and directives of 20 U.S.C. 1414(d)(1)(D), with the responsible sending entity implied rather than explicitly designated in the source.
